title: Mobius Cycle State (cycle.json)
description: Schema for the authoritative cycle pointer at repo root. cycle.json is canon: malformed state must not merge. Introduced C-339.

current_cycle.description: Cycle pointer, e.g. C-339. Arithmetic from the C-288 = 2026-04-21 anchor (see mobius-bot-state-sync.yml).

gi.description: Global Integrity. Attested value; carried forward (and marked in notes) when the ledger is unreachable.

gi_attested_this_cycle.description: True once this cycle has had a writer run that received a non-null gi from the ledger pulse and wrote it into `gi` (i.e. `gi_attested_at == current_cycle`). False means no run this cycle has attested a value yet, and `gi` is carried forward unchanged from `gi_attested_at`; see `gi_withheld_reason`. A later same-cycle rerun whose own ledger fetch fails does not flip this back to false — mobius-bot-state-sync.yml permits workflow_dispatch catch-up runs alongside the scheduled cron, and a transient retry failure must not unattest an earlier success. Never scrubbed on cycle rollover.

gi_withheld_reason.description: Present only when gi_attested_this_cycle is false. One of the ledger fetch withheld reasons (e.g. LEDGER_PULSE_UNREACHABLE, LEDGER_URL_UNCONFIGURED) or GI_NULL_IN_PULSE when the pulse was reachable but returned gi=null.
